description: SMOKE cross-binding conformance: MPAS cell rings derived IN-DOCUMENT feeding the conservative regridder on the sphere. Source: the 12 pentagonal Voronoi cells of the icosahedral level-0 mesh (grids/mpas/mesh/level0.esm mounted as a subsystem; the mesh files are the library's one allowed precomputation, provenance in their _doc), with src_poly produced by grids/mpas/grid.esm's mpas_cell_rings_deg template over the WIDENED mesh contract (latVertex/lonVertex/verticesOnCell; rad->deg conversion in the template; the min(k, nEdgesOnCell) pad clamp never fires at level 0 where every cell has exactly MAXEDGES = 5 vertices). Target: the 8 spherical octants (inline const triangles, exactly-shared pole/equator vertex spellings, tiling the sphere: A_j expected pi/2 each). Mixed vertex counts (pentagon sources x triangle targets) exercise the narrow phase's whole-ring slicing -- the production MPAS-to-latlon shape. Dense narrow phase at manifold 'spherical' (GeometryOps great-circle clipping in Julia, s2geometry in Rust; CONFORMANCE_SPEC 5.8.4 -- different kernels, same manifold declaration, agreement tolerance-gated). Gates: partition-of-unity exact by construction (tight epsilon); conservation at 1e-9 sr (the octants tile the sphere, mass_src = 26*pi from the committed areaCell); per-pair A_ij/A_j/W_ij against the Julia-runner golden at the 5.8 tolerances below. Several dodecahedron vertices lie EXACTLY on the octant boundary great circles, so boundary-degenerate clips are deliberately in scope -- the 5.8.2 sliver floor absorbs them identically in numerator and denominator.

blocked_upstream_bindings.python: spherical clip requires the pinned optional dependency spherely==0.1.0 ([geometry] extra; S2 via s2geography) -- no cp314 macOS-arm64 wheel and the source build needs the s2geography C++ stack, so the kernel's backend is uninstallable in the conformance venv today; the planar cases are unaffected and this case activates for python as soon as the pinned dep installs

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator

tolerances._doc: Keys follow the spherical exemplar conservative_overlap_sphere_fan_4_to_2 (areas in steradians on the unit sphere). characteristic_length 1.0 rad puts the sliver floor at 1e-15 sr, far below the true pentagon-octant overlaps (order 0.1 sr) and above backend snap slivers from the exactly-on-boundary dodecahedron vertices. Conservation is gated at 1e-9 (exact tiling; residual is clip noise), partition-of-unity at the tight epsilon (exact by construction).

reference_expectations._doc: NON-GOLDEN eyeball anchors (no hand-exact per-pair values exist for pentagon-octant clips): A_j = pi/2 = 1.5707963267948966 sr for every octant (they tile the sphere and the denominator row-sums the computed areas); sum_j A_j = 4*pi; mass_src = mass_tgt = 26*pi = 81.68140899333463 with F_src = [1..12] and the committed areaCell = pi/3 per cell; every W_ij column sums to 1.
